LanguageData.LP_MageArmor.label: mage armor
LanguageData.LP_MageArmor.description: An invisible layer of force: sharp and blunt armor +25%.
LanguageData.LP_ShieldSpell.label: shield
LanguageData.LP_ShieldSpell.description: A layer of arcane shield: damage taken is absorbed by the shield first (severity = remaining absorption).
LanguageData.LP_MirrorImage.label: mirror image
LanguageData.LP_MirrorImage.description: Illusory duplicates (severity = remaining duplicates): each time an enemy attack hits, one duplicate is used up and that hit misses.

LanguageData.LP_MirrorImage.stages._2.label: 2 duplicates
LanguageData.LP_MirrorImage.stages._3.label: 3 duplicates
LanguageData.LP_MagicSleep.label: magical sleep
LanguageData.LP_MagicSleep.description: Put down by a sleep spell, consciousness reduced to 10%.
LanguageData.LP_Haste.label: hasted
LanguageData.LP_Haste.description: Movement ×1.5, work speed ×1.3, melee cooldown ×0.8. Lethargic for an hour afterwards.
LanguageData.LP_HasteFatigue.label: haste lethargy
LanguageData.LP_Blessed.label: bless
LanguageData.LP_Blessed.description: Blessed by a cleric: melee hit +10%, better shooting accuracy, mood +3.
LanguageData.LP_Guided.label: guided
LanguageData.LP_Guided.description: Guided by a guidance spell: global work speed +15%, learning speed +30%.
LanguageData.LP_StaunchBleeding.label: divine hemostasis
LanguageData.LP_StaunchBleeding.description: Lesser restoration has stopped all bleeding.
LanguageData.LP_DeathWard.label: death ward
LanguageData.LP_DeathWard.description: Pain ×0.5. When it would be downed by injuries, instantly heals 30 × divine power injury and uses up this ward.
LanguageData.LP_Entangled.label: entangled
LanguageData.LP_Entangled.stages.1.label: large
LanguageData.LP_Barkskin.label: barkskin
LanguageData.LP_Barkskin.description: Skin hard as bark: sharp armor +30%, blunt armor +15%, movement ×0.95.
LanguageData.LP_Conjured.label: spirit summons
LanguageData.LP_Conjured.description: A summoned spirit: vanishes into motes of light when time is up, leaves no corpse when it dies.
LanguageData.LP_WildShape.label: bear form
LanguageData.LP_WildShape.description: Become a bear: fights with bear claws and bites, melee damage × primal power, damage taken ×0.6, movement ×1.15; cannot do fine work.
LanguageData.LP_BeastFrenzy.label: beast lord's call
LanguageData.LP_BeastFrenzy.description: A beast commanded by a druid: melee damage increased, movement ×1.2, damage taken ×0.8.
LanguageData.LP_Twinned.label: metamagic: twinned
LanguageData.LP_Twinned.description: The next single-target sorcerer spell will also affect a second target.
LanguageData.LP_Empowered.label: metamagic: empowered
LanguageData.LP_Empowered.description: The next sorcerer spells deal ×1.5 damage (severity = remaining uses).
LanguageData.LP_DragonWingsLanded.label: dragon wing
LanguageData.LP_DragonWingsLanded.description: Just took flight on dragon wings: melee dodge +20%.
LanguageData.LP_SorcerousSurge.label: wild surge
LanguageData.LP_SorcerousSurge.description: Magic surges inside: sorcerer spells cost no mana, cooldown ×0.25, and each cast has a 20% chance of wild magic.
LanguageData.LP_WildInvisible.label: wild magic: invisibility
LanguageData.LP_WildInvisible.description: Wild magic made the body vanish for a few seconds.
LanguageData.LP_Overcharge.label: overcharged shot
LanguageData.LP_Overcharge.description: The next ranged hit deals ×(1 + artifice power) damage, and the weapon loses 5% durability. Fades if nothing is hit within 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneCharged.label: arcane charge
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneCharged.description: Magic infused by an artificer: +0.5 magic factor when using runic dwarven firearms and staves.
